name: inkubator
description: Local-first desktop application for the management and cataloging of fountain pen and ink collections.

scripts.build:win: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:mac: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles dmg,app
scripts.build:linux: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles deb,rpm
scripts.build:linux:deb: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles deb
scripts.build:linux:rpm: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles rpm
scripts.test: node --test tests/critical-persistence.test.js tests/data-schema.test.js tests/release-version.test.js tests/docker-cache.test.js tests/backup-archive.test.js tests/backup-schedule.test.js
